tasks.check: deno task res:build && deno task test
tasks.check:full: deno task res:clean && deno task res:build && deno task test && deno task bench
tasks.check:security: deno task res:build && deno check src/**/*.res.js
tasks.bundle: deno task res:build && deno bundle src/Common/Alib_String.res.js dist/alib-string.bundle.js
tasks.bundle:check: deno task bundle && deno check dist/alib-string.bundle.js
